integration_worktree.report_commit_note: This qualification report is committed in the immediately following documentation commit; the pushed branch tip is the authoritative closure head.

mock_provider.basis: Contract, error-matrix, redaction, diagnostics, workflow, approval, rollback, path-safety, CLI and end-to-end tests pass. Deterministic fixtures are labelled test doubles and are not capability evidence.

real_provider.basis: No credentials or endpoint were configured. The opt-in live harness exists but was skipped; no paid calls were made.

native_model.basis: No compatible canonical taksh-foundation-111m checkpoint exists among inspected artifacts. Native adapter is fail-closed with no fallback.

production_deployment.basis: Security, deployment, operational, and supply-chain qualification remain outstanding.
